as_a_commercial_property_insurer_we: “As a commercial property insurer, we rely on accurate and well-reasoned actuarial work to assess and manage our risk exposure. Actuarial Factor brings deep technical knowledge of this market and an understanding of the factors that matter most to our line of business. What truly sets them apart is how easy they are to work with. Actuarial analysis rarely gets finalized in a single pass; it usually involves revisiting and refining data, and going back and forth as new information comes in. They make this process seamless. They respond quickly, explain their reasoning clearly, and adjust their work without friction. We value them not just as a service provider but as a partner we can trust, and we would recommend them to any insurer looking for expertise paired with outstanding communication.”
as_our_trip_came_to_an: As our trip came to an end, I started to wonder whether I would ever find a name he liked. Then I said, “Actuarial Factor.” This time, my son approved.

Espy works in Actuarial Factor’s home office located in Coral Gables, Florida.

We work with insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurtechs, captives, and self-insured organizations. Our multilingual team combines technical rigor with clear, direct communication. We explain our findings and their implications so you can make decisions with greater clarity.

prior_to_joining_actuarial_factor_diego: Prior to joining Actuarial Factor, Diego started his career as a Data Analyst at the consulting firm akya. His main tasks were processing and analyzing databases to provide insights into the client’s credit portfolio profitability. He then worked as a Reinsurance Broker for the firm THB México, where his main task was the placement of reinsurance accounts on national and international markets, with a focus on casualty, financial lines, construction and engineering risks.
prior_to_joining_actuarial_factor_in: Prior to joining Actuarial Factor in 2022, Karla held actuarial roles with Chubb (formerly ACE Group), Assurant Solutions, and Seguros Monterrey (a New York Life company), where she specialized in reserving and pricing analyses for the Latin American market. She has broad expertise across commercial and personal property and casualty insurance (P&C), accident and health insurance (A&H), and life insurance. In addition, she has extensive experience with warranty and service contract products, including wireless device protection, vehicle service contracts, and extended service contracts. Karla works in Actuarial Factor’s home office located in Coral Gables, Florida.
prior_to_joining_actuarial_factor_llc: Prior to joining Actuarial Factor, LLC in 2025 as Office Manager, Barbara spent more than two decades with Chubb Latin America (formerly ACE Group), holding positions of increasing responsibility in both Mexico and Miami. During her tenure, she managed and supported regional financial reporting, planning, forecasting, accounting, and expense management activities across multiple Latin American countries. She played a key role in financial close processes, budgeting, strategic planning, business integrations, and major implementation projects, while serving as a liaison between regional operations and corporate headquarters. Barbara works in Actuarial Factor’s home office located in Coral Gables, Florida.
prior_to_joining_actuarial_factor_perla: Prior to joining Actuarial Factor, Perla began her actuarial career at Seguros Banorte in 2018, where she served as Head of Reserves. In this role, she was responsible for actuarial reserve valuations, performing experience and performance analyses, including reserve backtesting, and coordinating the preparation and filing of regulatory reports in accordance with Mexican insurance requirements. Her work encompassed various short-term and long-term life and health insurance portfolios. She also served as Project Coordinator, overseeing several projects, coordinating teams, and managing projects through completion.

when_i_got_home_the_first: When I got home, the first thing I did was pull out the Oxford English Dictionary and look up the word factor. One of the definitions described taking something complex and making it simpler. I loved it. The meaning felt like a perfect reflection of what I wanted my company to do: help clients understand complex actuarial matters by making them clear and simple. To this day, that promise remains at the heart of Actuarial Factor.
